query_text: Create a trip planner tool on my phone that lets me filter places to visit by whether they are good for families with kids, so I can quickly pick things like playgrounds, kid-friendly museums, and calm parks while avoiding spots that are too crowded or not suitable for little ones. I want to be able to tap a few options and see only the matching places listed clearly.

Build a travel route planner app for my phone that works well for people who have trouble walking long distances or use a wheelchair, so I can plan a route that avoids stairs, steep hills, and narrow paths. I want it to show me step-by-step directions that only use flat walkways and accessible entrances, and let me tap through each part of the route one screen at a time.

Make a travel planner tool on my phone that highlights the more eco-friendly ways to get around and stay at a destination, like trains instead of flights, or hotels that use less plastic and waste, so I can see right away which options are better for the environment and pick those first when I am putting my trip together.

Build a trip planning tool on my phone that shows me all the festivals, local events, and public holidays happening at the destination on the dates I plan to visit, so I can see at a glance what is going on each day and plan around things like road closures, crowded markets, or special shows I might want to catch while I am there.

Create a beach holiday packing checklist app on my phone that covers all the essentials I need to bring, things like sunscreen, swimwear, towels, sandals, a hat, and a waterproof bag for my belongings. I want to be able to go through the list and check off each item as I pack it, and also add a few things of my own that are not already on there.

Need a packing guide app on my phone specifically for business trips where I want to travel with as little luggage as possible, so it gives me a tight list of only the must-have items like a few outfits that mix and match, essential toiletries in small sizes, my laptop charger, and the documents I need, nothing extra.

Build a packing list app on my phone for trips to cold destinations that helps me figure out how to layer my clothes properly so I stay warm without overpacking. I want it to tell me what base layers, mid layers, and outer layers I actually need, and remind me about things like thermal socks, gloves, and a warm hat so I do not forget anything important.

Build a packing list app on my phone for the one-bag travel challenge where I am trying to fit everything into a single carry-on backpack for a trip, so it helps me keep the list really tight and shows me exactly what to bring, what to leave behind, and how to choose versatile items that work for multiple days and different occasions.

Need a countdown checklist app on my phone that shows all the things I need to do on the day before I leave for a trip, organized by how urgent they are, like confirming my booking, charging my devices, packing last-minute items, and double-checking I have my passport and tickets, so I can work through it all in order without missing anything.

An airport transit checklist tool on my phone where I can go through every item I need to have ready before I get to the gate, things like my passport, boarding pass, local currency for the destination, and anything else I always forget under pressure, so I can tap through them one by one and feel confident I have not left anything important behind.

Need a travel prep app on my phone that tells me which vaccinations or health requirements I need before visiting a specific destination, so I do not have to search around different websites trying to figure it out myself. I just want to type in where I am going and see a clear list of what shots or health steps I need to take and roughly how far in advance.

A pet travel checklist app on my phone that walks me through every document and requirement I need to bring my dog or cat along on a trip, like health certificates, vaccination records, microchip info, and airline or destination rules, so I can check things off as I get them sorted and not panic at the last minute wondering if I missed something important.

A baby and toddler packing guide on my phone that lists all the things I actually need to bring when traveling with a young child, like diapers, formula, a compact stroller, medicines, and familiar comfort items, organized in a way that I can check off as I pack and make sure I have not forgotten anything that would be really hard to find once we are away from home.

Create a navigation tool on my phone that watches traffic on my route in real time and warns me when something is slowing down ahead, then automatically shows me a faster way around it, because I am always getting stuck in surprise jams with no warning and then showing up late. I just want my phone to handle the rerouting for me so I do not have to figure it out while driving.

Create a route planner on my phone that tells me exactly how much I will have to pay in tolls before I leave, broken down by each toll point along the way, because I hate reaching a tollbooth with no cash and no idea how much it costs. I want to type in my start and end point and get a clear total so I can decide whether it is worth taking the toll road at all.

Build a navigation tool on my phone that shows me all the electric vehicle charging stations along my route when I am driving, because I always get nervous my battery is going to die before I reach one. I want to see them on the map as I go, know which ones are available right now, and tap to add a stop at one without having to leave the app or look it up somewhere else.

A parking finder tool on my phone that shows me open spots near wherever I am headed so I stop wasting time circling the block when I arrive. I want to see what is nearby, whether it costs anything, and how far I would have to walk to my destination, all on one screen I can check quickly before I even pull into the area.

A walking safety tool on my phone that tells me how safe it is to walk through a certain area at night before I actually go there, because sometimes I just do not know a neighborhood and I would rather check first. I want to put in a street or area and get a simple score or rating with a quick explanation of what to watch out for so I can decide whether to go or find another way.

Make a walking navigation tool on my phone that shows me pedestrian crossing locations along my route and tells me roughly how long the signal stays green, because I am always rushing across intersections or waiting way longer than expected. I just want to know where the crossings are and how much time I have so I can walk at a normal pace and stop guessing.

Make a border crossing tool on my phone that shows me how long the wait is at each crossing point right now, because I have wasted hours sitting in line when a nearby crossing was completely empty. I want to pick my destination, see the current wait times for nearby crossings, and choose the one with the shortest line before I even start driving.

Create a public restroom finder on my phone that shows me where the nearest toilets are when I am out walking, because this is genuinely one of the most stressful things about being in an unfamiliar area. I want to tap once and see the closest options on a small map, whether they are free or not, and which direction to walk so I can get there quickly.

Create a city tour tool on my phone that shows me what a place looked like historically compared to how it looks today when I walk around, because I always wonder what the old buildings or streets used to be and there is no easy way to find out in the moment. I want to tap a spot on the map and see an old photo or description overlaid so I can learn about it without having to search around.

Need a weather app on my phone that shows a live animated radar map so I can see exactly where it is raining right now and which direction the rain is moving, because I am always getting caught off guard by showers when the regular forecast just says a percentage chance. I want to open my phone and immediately see the actual rain moving on the map so I know whether to wait it out or leave now.

Need a weather tool on my phone that tells me what the temperature actually feels like outside rather than just the number, and then suggests what I should wear based on that, because I always check the forecast and still end up either freezing or sweating. Just tell me it feels like 10 degrees and to wear a coat and scarf so I stop having to figure it out myself every morning.

A ski resort snow condition tracker on my phone that shows me the current snow depth and which slopes are open at any resort I search for, because I have driven all the way up to a mountain before and half the runs were closed and the snow was icy. I want to check before I go, see the conditions right now, and decide whether it is actually worth making the trip.

Make a beach wave checker app for my phone that saves me the hassle of driving out only to find the surf is way too rough or too flat to bother. I want to look up a beach, see the current wave height, and get a simple suitability rating like good/okay/bad for swimming or surfing so I can decide in one glance whether it's worth the trip.

Need a weather advisory app for my phone that tells farmers and anyone growing crops what the weather means for their fields, like whether it's a good day to spray, harvest, or irrigate. The app should show a plain-language advisory for the current conditions and a heads-up for the next few days so I can plan without having to interpret raw weather data myself.

Create a weather suitability checker for outdoor events and festivals as a mobile app, because it's always a pain figuring out if an outdoor show or market day is going to be rained out or blisteringly hot. I want to type in an event date and location and get a clear verdict on whether conditions are suitable, with a breakdown of rain chance, temperature, and wind so I can decide whether to go or skip it.

A lightning and thunderstorm alert app for my phone that shows a live map of where lightning strikes are happening right now and sends a warning when a storm is getting close to my area. The home screen should show the map with strike markers updating in real time, plus a countdown-style alert telling me how many minutes away the storm is so I know when to get indoors.

Make a wildfire smoke and ash advisory app for my phone that tells me how bad the air is right now from nearby wildfires and whether it's safe to go outside. I want a quick health rating for my area, a note on what the ash and smoke levels mean for breathing, and a simple recommendation like stay in or okay to go out, so I stop guessing every time there's a fire season.

Create a destination weather comparison tool as a mobile app that lets me type in two or three places I'm considering for a trip and see their weather side by side for the dates I'm planning to go. I always waste time jumping between different apps trying to compare, so I want one screen that lines up temperature, rain chance, and overall conditions for each spot so I can just pick the best one.

Create a cycle hire station finder app for my phone that shows a map of all the nearby bike-share docking stations and tells me in real time how many bikes are available at each one. I hate walking to a station only to find it empty, so I want to tap a station on the map and see the current bike count and number of free docks before I leave the house.

Build a nearby electric scooter finder app for my phone that shows me all the rentable e-scooters within walking distance on a map, with battery level and estimated range shown for each one. I hate wandering around looking for a scooter with enough charge to get me where I'm going, so I want to open the app and immediately spot the closest one worth riding.

A night bus and last-service alert app for my phone that tells me exactly what time the last bus on my usual routes leaves tonight and sends a reminder before it goes so I stop missing it. The app should let me save my regular night routes and show a countdown to the last departure for each one, so I always know when I need to start heading to the stop.

Build a park-and-ride planner app for my phone that shows all the park-and-ride lots near my destination, their connecting bus or tram schedules, and the total parking cost for the day. I always end up paying for overpriced city parking because I never know if a park-and-ride is actually nearby or worth it, so I want to see schedule and price together in one place before I set off.

A mobile-first guide app for crossing borders by public transport, showing all the bus, train, and shuttle options between two countries, with departure times and how long each journey takes. I can never find clear info in one place when I need to cross a border without a car, so this app should show the full list of transport options and their schedules on a single screen so I can just pick one and go.

Need a timetable app for my phone that covers funicular railways and cable cars, because these are always the hardest to find schedules for when I'm out exploring hilly places. I want to search by location or line name, see the full day's departure times, and know the last ride up and last ride down so I never get stuck at the top of a hill after closing time.

Make a long-distance coach departure board app for my phone that shows upcoming coach departures from a bus station I choose, with the destination, departure time, and platform number listed clearly. I always have to stand squinting at physical boards at the station, so I want to check everything from my phone in advance and know which platform to head to before I even walk through the door.

Build a real-time arrival board app for my phone that shows predicted arrival times for buses and trains at any stop or station I search for, updating live like the screens at the stop itself. I spend too much time refreshing other apps that show wrong times, so I want one clean board that shows the next few arrivals with countdown minutes remaining so I know exactly when to leave the house.

Make a journey cost calculator app for my phone that lets me enter a multi-leg trip, like bus then metro then train, and shows the price for each leg plus a running total so I can see the full fare before I commit to the route. I always get surprised by how much a trip costs when you string different transport types together, and I want a quick breakdown I can check on the spot.

Make a food picker app for my phone that helps me and my friends stop arguing about what to eat for lunch or dinner. I want to spin a wheel or tap a button and have it randomly pick a type of food or a nearby restaurant category for us, with a short list of options I can customize, so we stop wasting fifteen minutes every day just deciding where to go.

Make a random meal picker app that I can open on my phone when I have absolutely no idea what to eat and just need something to decide for me. It should let me set a few preferences like spicy or mild, cheap or splurge, eat in or takeout, and then give me one clear pick with a short reason, so I stop standing in the kitchen staring into space every evening.

A little phone app that just tells me what to eat today when my brain is too tired to decide. You open it up, tap once, and it spins through a list of options based on your mood or hunger level and lands on something specific, like ramen or a sandwich place nearby, so you stop overthinking it and just go eat.

Build a what-should-I-eat-today app for my phone that randomly picks a meal idea for me each time I open it, pulling from a personal list of foods and restaurants I've added myself. I want to be able to save my favorites, mark ones I've tried recently so they cool down for a while, and get a fresh pick with one tap so I never have the same decision paralysis at mealtimes.

Make a daily food randomizer app for my phone that picks what I eat for each meal of the day so I stop making the same boring choices on autopilot. I want to give it a few categories I like and a rough budget, and it generates a meal suggestion for breakfast, lunch, and dinner that I can swap out with one tap if I feel like changing my mind.

Need a quick food decision app for my phone that ends the daily what-to-eat debate in our household. Everyone can add their own food preferences into the app, and when we can not agree, we hit a button and it fairly picks something that works for the group, maybe with a filter for whether we want to cook at home or order in.

Make a meal roulette app for my phone that spins through a set of restaurant types or dish ideas whenever I tap the spin button. I want to load it up with a personal list of cuisines and places I like, and every spin gives me one random pick so lunch decisions take five seconds instead of ruining my whole break trying to think of something.

Create a random food picker app for my phone that I can use when I genuinely cannot decide what to eat and just need the app to make the call for me. I want it to have a list of options I can edit and tag, like quick, hot, vegetarian, and so on, so the random pick is at least in the right ballpark for my mood that day.

Need a portion size reference app for my phone that shows me visually how much a proper serving of common foods actually looks like, because I have no idea what 100 grams of rice or a serving of pasta is supposed to look like on a plate. I want to look up a food, see a clear picture or comparison to a common object like a fist or a deck of cards, and get the calories and rough weight so I can stop guessing every meal.

Make a fasting and calorie tracker app for my phone that handles intermittent fasting windows alongside what I eat each day. I want to set my eating window, track when my fast starts and ends with a simple timer, and log meals with their calorie counts so I can see if I'm staying within my goal for the day, all in one app without needing to switch between a fasting timer and a food diary.
